name: KButton
summary: Every act a person can take. Ink primary for the screen's one act; outline and ghost for the rest; danger for an irreversible act.

variant.description: primary = the screen's one act (ink); outline = row actions and secondary choices; ghost = toolbars and quiet acts; danger = an irreversible act (vermilion words, never filled).

sm.description: 28px in a toolbar or row; every size is 44px on a phone.

iconOnly.description: Icon-only: the label becomes aria-label and title.

label.description: The words on the button (sentence case, a verb).

docked.description: The screen's one primary that the phone dock also carries: hidden in its card on a phone.

busy.description: The busy face ("Starting…") while the act runs.

notes: Icon-only buttons are named by label (aria-label and title).
Focus is a 2px ink outline; never removed.
An act shows its busy face until the outcome is known; a refusal restores it and says why in place.

do: One primary per screen; on a phone it lives in the dock.
Row actions are outline sm, 108px minimum, in the same column on every row.
dont: Never make navigation the primary act.
